parent.description: the feature the gate stacked on; main for a bottom feature with children (gate and wait); "" when it built on public main and nothing is stacked on it

base.description: the commit the feature's own commits were replayed onto: public main, or the rebased tip of the features below it; "" when a stacked gate stopped before the features below it were built

scanned_as.description: the mode the leak scan covered: preserve scans every commit, squash and curated the final tree

commits.description: The feature's commits as the gate replayed them, oldest first, for drafting a --curate file; empty when the replay didn't finish.

shadow_pr.description: the gate PR in the shadow repo; null when none was opened (the gate failed before CI, a dry run, or a reused gate this promote didn't wait on)

job.description: the gate's CI wait, for wait: gate/<feature>/<12 hex>; null when no candidate was pushed (a leak, a conflict, a dry run, or a reused gate this promote didn't wait on)

children.description: the live features stacked directly on it (gate and wait); absent when there are none

chain.description: the unpublished stack from its bottom up to it, as promote lists it (gate and wait); absent for a feature with neither parent nor children
